description: Run `forge test` and return a compact summary: counts, and for each failing test its kind (unit, fuzz, invariant, setup), decoded reason, fuzz counterexample or invariant call sequence, and console logs. isError means the tests did not run (compile error, no matching tests, timeout, missing forge, …); never report that as passing.

fuzz_runs.description: Override fuzz runs. A value below the project setting is reported as reduced; do not use it to make tests pass.

match_contract.description: Only run test contracts matching this regex.

match_path.description: Only run test files matching this glob.

match_test.description: Only run test functions matching this regex.

traces.description: Attach a decoded trace excerpt to the first 5 failures (a second, text-mode forge run). Default true.

name: run_tests
